title: Junior .NET Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We seek a proficient Junior .NET Developer capable of maintaining high standards of technical quality and innovation, dedicated to continuous improvement, and committed to assisting clients worldwide. Success in this role requires detailed knowledge of development techniques, excellent communication, and organizational skills.


Key responsibilities:


- Architect and develop various services and APIs

- Apply SOLID principles to craft maintainable and high-quality code

- Collaborate with product owners to ensure features/changes align with business requirements and degreed strategy

- Engage closely with designers, UX, and other developers to grasp new features, dependencies, and technical intricacies

- Fulfill other assigned duties


Requirements:


- Advanced proficiency in English (spoken and written)

- Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL Databases

- Experience with Microservices and the Cloud

- Knowledge of algorithms

title: Video Editor
description:
We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

description:

Nosso objetivo central é transformar a perspectiva das empresas em relação às finanças e operações corporativas . Já operamos um cartão de crédito PJ e estamos expandindo nosso portfólio com novos produtos de crédito como Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL), capital de giro e antecipação de recebíveis.

Estamos procurando uma pessoa Full Stack Developer para se juntar ao nosso time.


Buscamos uma pessoa Full Stack Developer para fortalecer nossa área de Tech.


Você busca um ambiente no qual fará parte de inovações desde o #Dia1 ?


Quer ter opções de ações e fazer parte de uma startup bem capitalizada que está pronta para acelerar?

title: Editor de vídeo
description:
Descrição da Empresa

Descrição da Empresa : A Le But é uma assessoria estratégica de marketing e branding especializada em clínicas e consultórios que desejam elevar sua percepção de valor, atrair pacientes com desejo e vender com consistência. Atuamos no ponto onde posicionamento, experiência e conversão se encontram, criando marcas memoráveis, jornadas encantadoras e estratégias que geram resultados reais.

Na prática, isso significa transformar a forma como médicos, dentistas, biomédicas e outros profissionais da saúde se comunicam com o mercado, através de um marketing que vende, encanta e posiciona com autoridade. Somos especialistas em construir marcas desejadas e clínicas de alto padrão e buscamos profissionais que queiram crescer junto com a gente.




Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Editor de Reels que esteja disposto a aprender mais. Este papel é focado na criação, edição e produção de conteúdo de vídeo para diversos projetos. As responsabilidades diárias incluem editar vídeos, fazer correção de cor, criar gráficos em movimento e colaborar com a equipe para garantir que os projetos atendam aos padrões esperados. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e remoto.


Qualificações

  • Produção e Edição de Vídeo: Necessário possuir experiência em edição de vídeo.
  • Além das habilidades acima, serão considerados diferenciais a familiaridade com softwares adicionais de design e edição e experiência comprovada em projetos de vídeo em diversos setores.

title: Analista de Conteúdo Senior (Temporário)
description:
Analista de Conteúdo Sênior (Temporário)


Como Analista de Conteúdo Sênior, seu objetivo será desenvolver a estratégia, cronograma e conteúdos dos projetos com foco na geração e captura de demanda em projetos para empresas do segmento B2B.


ATENÇÃO : Para participar do processo seletivo é necessário se candidatar pelo site. Copie e cole este link no seu navegador:


Qual é o perfil de profissional que buscamos?

  • Senso crítico para fazer perguntas e buscar respostas através dos dados.
  • Senso de urgência para agir de forma proativa e efetiva na resolução de problemas e novas oportunidades em projetos.
  • Com foco na meta para sugerir melhorias e alterações de rota quando necessário.
  • Comunicativo para transitar em várias áreas e projetos.
  • Vendedor, no sentido de apresentar soluções e pontos de vista.
  • Organizado com a gestão de tempo, tarefas e agenda de reuniões.
  • Que esteja alinhado com os valores da BRSA:
  • Aqui não se faz sacanagem.
  • Foco no foco do cliente.
  • Fazemos com excelência.
  • Iniciativa para trazer soluções.
  • Sentimento de time e cuidado.
  • Que tenha conhecimento de estratégias, como:
  • Inbound Marketing
  • Account Based Marketing
  • Social Selling
  • Geração de demanda


Requisitos para a vaga

  • Experiência no segmento B2B
  • Experiência em conteúdo para artigos, materiais ricos, e-mails, redes sociais, anúncios e sites.
  • Experiência em RD Station e ActiveCampaign para criação de e-mails, automações e atividades de gerenciamento da base de contatos.
  • Residir em Campinas e região ou São Paulo e região


Sua responsabilidade será:

  • Planejar a estratégia de conteúdo, definindo frequência e canais adequados.
  • Desenvolvimento e revisão do conteúdo para diversos canais digitais, visando visibilidade do cliente.
  • Desenvolvimento de e-mails, automações, segmentações e gestão da base de contatos.
  • Participação em reuniões com clientes para desenvolvimento de briefing, aprovação e alterações.
  • Criar, manter e atualizar calendários editoriais para controle de cronogramas de projeto.
  • Oferecer suporte técnico e compartilhar conhecimento com a equipe
  • Preparar relatórios que forneçam dados sobre a performance de e-mails e redes sociais


Formato da Vaga

  • 100% remota
  • Regime de contratação CLT
  • Buscamos candidatos(as) que residem em:
  • Campinas e região
  • São Paulo e região (como ABC Paulista e Jundiaí)


Salário e Benefícios

  • Salário compatível com o mercado
  • CLT
  • Day off de aniversário
  • Plano de Saúde (Porto Seguro)
  • Plano Odontológico
  • Participação nos lucros (PLR)
  • Vale-refeição e Vale-alimentação (Cartão Flash)
  • Seguro de Vida

title: Senior HR/ADM Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Senior HR ADM Analyst with English to join our Human Resources team. We are looking for proactive, dynamic people and team players, with great organizational capacity, accustomed to handling multiple tasks, and with marked attention to detail. It is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!


Key responsibilities:


- Supervise the pre-liquidation of salaries and the impact on earnings.

- Supervise the process of registering and terminating our employees.

- Actively participate in the improvement of the area and cross-area processes.

- Collaborate in the HR-ADM area and interact with external entities/suppliers.

- Prepare reports and reports required by management or other control areas.


Requirements:


- Advanced student or graduate of careers related to the search.

- 3 years of work experience in similar positions.

- Knowledge of Law 20,744 and its application.

- Knowledge about 4th earnings. Category.

- Experience in service companies.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Compliance Specialist
description:
Compliance Specialist

We are seeking a remote, full-time SOC 2 Compliance Specialist with expertise in SaaS environments and proficiency in using compliance management platforms (preferably Vanta). The ideal candidate will lead the client's SOC 2 compliance efforts, streamline evidence collection, ensure continuous monitoring, and support security and compliance programs to meet industry standards and customer expectations.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, enhance grid health, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • SOC 2 Compliance Management : Lead the end-to-end process for achieving and maintaining SOC 2 compliance, including scoping, evidence collection, control implementation, and audit preparation using Vanta's platform
  • Vanta Platform Utilization : Leverage Vanta's AI and automation tools to streamline compliance workflows, monitor controls, and manage vendor risk assessments
  • Continuous Monitoring : Implement and oversee continuous monitoring processes to ensure ongoing adherence to SOC 2 requirements and other relevant frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, GDPR)
  • Policy Development : Develop, update, and maintain security and compliance policies, procedures, and documentation within Vantas' centralized platform
  • Vendor Risk Management : Utilize Vanta's Vendor Risk Management (VRM) solution to assess and monitor third-party vendors, ensuring compliance with security standards
  • Audit Support : Collaborate with external auditors to facilitate smooth and efficient SOC 2 audits, utilizing Vanta's tools to provide real-time evidence and reporting
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work closely with engineering, IT, and product teams to integrate compliance requirements into SaaS product development and operations
  • Training and Awareness : Conduct training sessions for employees on SOC 2 compliance requirements and best practices for maintaining a secure SaaS environment
  • Reporting and Metrics : Use Vanta's reporting features to track compliance metrics, generate reports, and communicate the company's security posture to internal stakeholders and external clients
  • Stay Updated : Keep abreast of evolving compliance frameworks, security standards, and Vanta platform updates to ensure alignment with industry best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience in compliance, information security, or risk management, with a focus on SOC 2 compliance in a SaaS environment
  • Hands-on experience with Vanta or similar compliance automation platforms
  • Proven track record of successfully managing SOC 2 audits and implementing controls
  • Strong understanding of SaaS architecture, cloud security, and data privacy principles
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or NIST CSF
  • Proficiency in using compliance automation platforms for evidence collection, continuous monitoring, and vendor risk management
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills to manage complex compliance initiatives
  • Strong communication skills to liaise with technical teams, auditors, and leadership
  • Detail-oriented with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or SOC 2-specific training)
  • Familiarity with Vanta's AI Agent and other advanced features for GRC automation.
  • Experience working with startups, mid-market, or enterprise organizations in a SaaS environment
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. title: Compliance Specialist
description:
Compliance Specialist

We are seeking a remote, full-time SOC 2 Compliance Specialist with expertise in SaaS environments and proficiency in using compliance management platforms (preferably Vanta). The ideal candidate will lead the client's SOC 2 compliance efforts, streamline evidence collection, ensure continuous monitoring, and support security and compliance programs to meet industry standards and customer expectations.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, enhance grid health, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • SOC 2 Compliance Management : Lead the end-to-end process for achieving and maintaining SOC 2 compliance, including scoping, evidence collection, control implementation, and audit preparation using Vanta's platform
  • Vanta Platform Utilization : Leverage Vanta's AI and automation tools to streamline compliance workflows, monitor controls, and manage vendor risk assessments
  • Continuous Monitoring : Implement and oversee continuous monitoring processes to ensure ongoing adherence to SOC 2 requirements and other relevant frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, GDPR)
  • Policy Development : Develop, update, and maintain security and compliance policies, procedures, and documentation within Vantas' centralized platform
  • Vendor Risk Management : Utilize Vanta's Vendor Risk Management (VRM) solution to assess and monitor third-party vendors, ensuring compliance with security standards
  • Audit Support : Collaborate with external auditors to facilitate smooth and efficient SOC 2 audits, utilizing Vanta's tools to provide real-time evidence and reporting
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work closely with engineering, IT, and product teams to integrate compliance requirements into SaaS product development and operations
  • Training and Awareness : Conduct training sessions for employees on SOC 2 compliance requirements and best practices for maintaining a secure SaaS environment
  • Reporting and Metrics : Use Vanta's reporting features to track compliance metrics, generate reports, and communicate the company's security posture to internal stakeholders and external clients
  • Stay Updated : Keep abreast of evolving compliance frameworks, security standards, and Vanta platform updates to ensure alignment with industry best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience in compliance, information security, or risk management, with a focus on SOC 2 compliance in a SaaS environment
  • Hands-on experience with Vanta or similar compliance automation platforms
  • Proven track record of successfully managing SOC 2 audits and implementing controls
  • Strong understanding of SaaS architecture, cloud security, and data privacy principles
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or NIST CSF
  • Proficiency in using compliance automation platforms for evidence collection, continuous monitoring, and vendor risk management
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills to manage complex compliance initiatives
  • Strong communication skills to liaise with technical teams, auditors, and leadership
  • Detail-oriented with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or SOC 2-specific training)
  • Familiarity with Vanta's AI Agent and other advanced features for GRC automation.
  • Experience working with startups, mid-market, or enterprise organizations in a SaaS environment
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Customer Success Representative
description:
About MeetGeek

MeetGeek is an AI meeting assistant that doesn't just listen, it acts. We help teams automate meeting capture, summarization, and now, with agentic AI workflows, MeetGeek becomes an active participant in meetings, surfacing data, triggering automations, and even taking actions on your behalf.

From Zoom to Teams to Google Meet, MeetGeek integrates with 5,000+ tools like HubSpot, Slack, Notion, Salesforce, and more — helping revenue, product, and operations teams turn conversations into structured workflows.

Thousands of companies in 100+ countries already trust us. Backed by top-tier investors and led by a team of AI, NLP, and systems engineering veterans, MeetGeek is redefining what meetings can do.

It's a great time to join MeetGeek. We’re a quickly growing remote team, well-funded, and helping thousands of teams improve their meetings.


About MeetGeek

We’re looking for a Customer Success Representative (Junior) who’s passionate about helping customers succeed — and curious about what’s next in AI, automation, and workflow design.

This role blends customer support, customer success, and operations . You’ll help users go beyond meeting notes and unlock the full power of MeetGeek’s agentic capabilities — from automated follow-ups to real-time action triggers.


About the Role

Technical Troubleshooting

Support users through questions about agent setup, integrations, or system behavior. Collaborate with engineering to resolve edge cases.

Instrutor de Inglês

title: Engenheiro de Software - Full Stack Sênior
description:
A Deeptera, startup deeptech focada em construção de sistemas e agentes inteligentes avançados, está expandindo a equipe para atuar em projetos ousados de pesquisa e desenvolvimento (P&D) que envolvem tecnologias diversas como IA Generativa/LLMs, sistemas multiagentes, visão computacional, machine learning, Digital Twin e métodos de otimização. A empresa busca Engenheiro(a) de Software Fullstack Sênior com experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend e frontend, capaz de construir soluções escaláveis e de alto impacto. 


Responsabilidades e Competências

- Desenvolver e evoluir funcionalidades de plataformas de IA, garantindo alta performance e qualidade do código, propondo melhorias e refatorações quando necessário;

- Atuar no backend com Python (Django e FastAPI), conectando serviços e fontes de dados variadas.

- Implementar e integrar frontends em ReactJS, com foco em usabilidade e eficiência.

- Colaborar na (re)definição de soluções em arquitetura de microsserviços escaláveis.

- Participar de decisões técnicas e contribuir para boas práticas de engenharia de software.

- Participar em projeto de pesquisa aplicada e publicação de artigos científicos.

- Garantir a qualidade de códigos, com testes automatizados, code reviews, padrões técnicos e boas práticas.

- Apoiar implantação e melhoria de processos de produção de software.


Requisitos

- Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Backend em Python e Django.

- Experiência com JavaScript/TypeScript, ReactJS e FastAPI.

- Domínio de bancos de dados relacionais.

- Vivência em arquitetura de microsserviços e sistemas escaláveis.

- Uso de Azure DevOps e Git para versionamento e organização das tarefas. 

- Experiência com práticas de CI/CD, incluindo uso de pipelines automatizados.

- Experiência em uma ou mais plataforma de Nuvem (Azure, AWS, GCP).

- Inglês: intermediário.


Diferenciais/Desejável

- Experiência com outras stacks, como .NET e Angular.

- Conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial (frameworks, IA Generativa, LLMs).

- Experiência em Machine Learning aplicado a problemas reais.

- Participação de projetos de pesquisa com publicação de artigos.

- Mestrado/Doutorado na área ou interesse para estudos e formação avançada.

- Liderança e fluência em inglês.


Processo seletivo:

- Entrevista com avaliação técnica e RH.

- Entrevista com RH.


Modalidade/Formato:

- Dedicação: Atividade em tempo integral no formato Remoto.

- Formato de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ). 

- Remuneração: valor a ser definido conforme perfil e experiência

A empresa busca Engenheiro(a) de Software Fullstack Sênior com experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend e frontend, capaz de construir soluções escaláveis e de alto impacto. 


Responsabilidades e Competências

- Desenvolver e evoluir funcionalidades de plataformas de IA, garantindo alta performance e qualidade do código, propondo melhorias e refatorações quando necessário;

- Atuar no backend com Python (Django e FastAPI), conectando serviços e fontes de dados variadas.

- Implementar e integrar frontends em ReactJS, com foco em usabilidade e eficiência.

- Colaborar na (re)definição de soluções em arquitetura de microsserviços escaláveis.

- Participar de decisões técnicas e contribuir para boas práticas de engenharia de software.

- Participar em projeto de pesquisa aplicada e publicação de artigos científicos.

- Garantir a qualidade de códigos, com testes automatizados, code reviews, padrões técnicos e boas práticas.

- Apoiar implantação e melhoria de processos de produção de software.


Requisitos

- Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Backend em Python e Django.

- Experiência com JavaScript/TypeScript, ReactJS e FastAPI.

- Domínio de bancos de dados relacionais.

- Vivência em arquitetura de microsserviços e sistemas escaláveis.

- Uso de Azure DevOps e Git para versionamento e organização das tarefas. 

- Experiência com práticas de CI/CD, incluindo uso de pipelines automatizados.

- Experiência em uma ou mais plataforma de Nuvem (Azure, AWS, GCP).

- Inglês: intermediário.


Diferenciais/Desejável

- Experiência com outras stacks, como .NET e Angular.

- Conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial (frameworks, IA Generativa, LLMs).

- Experiência em Machine Learning aplicado a problemas reais.

- Participação de projetos de pesquisa com publicação de artigos.

- Mestrado/Doutorado na área ou interesse para estudos e formação avançada.

- Liderança e fluência em inglês.


Processo seletivo:

- Entrevista com avaliação técnica e RH.

- Entrevista com RH.


Modalidade/Formato:

- Dedicação: Atividade em tempo integral no formato Remoto.

- Formato de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ). 

- Remuneração: valor a ser definido conforme perfil e experiência

title: Android Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a skilled Android Engineer to lead the development of innovative mobile applications with a focus on cross-platform initiatives using Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) and Jetpack Compose. Experience with iOS development is a strong plus, as you’ll help shape our cross-platform architecture and deliver products that seamlessly operate across Android and iOS ecosystems.


Key Responsibilities


  • Architect, develop, and maintain mobile applications leveraging KMP for shared business logic and Compose for modern UI design.
  • Collaborate on cross-platform initiatives, contributing to both Android and iOS codebases when necessary.
  • Analyze and optimize high-volume mobile systems for performance and scalability.
  • Refactor and revitalize codebases as technology evolves.
  • Lead development efforts for new products and enhancements to existing products in response to market changes.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system failures, ensuring high-quality user experiences.
  • Work closely with other engineers, designers, and product managers to deliver innovative features.


Who You Are


  • 5+ years of experience in Android development with proficiency in Kotlin
  • Android Launcher experience is a strong plus
  • Hands-on experience with Jetpack Compose and modern Android architecture (MVVM, Clean Architecture).
  • Experience with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) or other cross-platform frameworks.
  • Exposure to or experience with iOS development (Swift or Objective-C) is a strong plus.
  • Strong architecture design skills and ability to build reusable UI components.
  • Comfortable working on collaborative, fast-paced engineering teams.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and time management skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Self-starter with entrepreneurial drive and passion for innovation.

Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a skilled Android Engineer to lead the development of innovative mobile applications with a focus on cross-platform initiatives using Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) and Jetpack Compose. Experience with iOS development is a strong plus, as you’ll help shape our cross-platform architecture and deliver products that seamlessly operate across Android and iOS ecosystems.


Key Responsibilities


  • Architect, develop, and maintain mobile applications leveraging KMP for shared business logic and Compose for modern UI design.
  • Collaborate on cross-platform initiatives, contributing to both Android and iOS codebases when necessary.
  • Analyze and optimize high-volume mobile systems for performance and scalability.
  • Refactor and revitalize codebases as technology evolves.
  • Lead development efforts for new products and enhancements to existing products in response to market changes.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system failures, ensuring high-quality user experiences.
  • Work closely with other engineers, designers, and product managers to deliver innovative features.


Who You Are


  • 5+ years of experience in Android development with proficiency in Kotlin
  • Android Launcher experience is a strong plus
  • Hands-on experience with Jetpack Compose and modern Android architecture (MVVM, Clean Architecture).
  • Experience with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) or other cross-platform frameworks.
  • Exposure to or experience with iOS development (Swift or Objective-C) is a strong plus.
  • Strong architecture design skills and ability to build reusable UI components.
  • Comfortable working on collaborative, fast-paced engineering teams.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and time management skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Self-starter with entrepreneurial drive and passion for innovation.

title: Software Developer (Mobile / AI-Enabled Workflow)
description:
Software Developer (Mobile / AI-Enabled Workflow)

We are looking for a talented software developer with strong mobile app development experience to join our team. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working across modern tech stacks, integrating AI into their workflow, and solving complex system-level problems that drive our product forward.

Must-Have Skills
  • Mobile app development experience (iOS preferred, Swift expertise required).
  • Familiarity with CICD pipelines and Git workflows.
  • Strong coding skills in at least two of the following:
  • Python
  • TypeScript
  • Swift
  • Experience building and integrating with REST or gRPC APIs.
  • Ability to solve complex system problems and contribute to key architectural decisions .
  • Strong sense of ownership over your work and outcomes.
Nice-to-Have Skills
  • Comfortable experimenting with and integrating AI tools in development workflows (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot).
  • Exposure to ML/AI engineering concepts , with strong interest in LLMs, embeddings, and agent-based systems .
  • Background in game design or interactive UX development.
  • Experience with Java or Android development (not required, but a plus).
What We’re Looking For
  • Someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment.
  • A developer who doesn’t just write code, but looks for smarter, more efficient ways to ship great products.
  • A team player with a growth mindset, positive attitude, and passion for building high-impact software.

title: Software Engineer - Frontend II
description:
Pride Global is hiring a Software Engineer - Frontend II - Brazilians only - Fluent in English

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Contract: Temporary (6 to 9 months)

An established and rapidly growing Ads organization is seeking a Senior Frontend Engineer to join the Campaign Management team. This team is focused on expanding and improving the core functionality that enables advertisers to create, edit, share, and analyze their ad campaigns with ease.

You’ll be working on key advertiser-facing tools, helping design and build experiences that are intuitive, scalable, and impactful. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute not just to new products, but also to the internal platform used by other product teams.


What You’ll Do

  • Work on the Ads platform UI , particularly features related to campaign creation and management
  • Contribute to and maintain the Ads Design System used across multiple teams
  • Build intuitive interfaces for advertisers to efficiently manage their campaigns
  • Collaborate with product, design, and backend engineers to define and deliver user-centric features
  • Take ownership of projects end-to-end — from technical design to launch and support
  • Participate in code reviews and continuously advocate for high-quality code and design standards
  • Help shape the evolution of the Ads experience from the frontend perspective


Tech Stack

  • Languages: TypeScript, Python
  • Frameworks & Libraries: React, React Query, Thrift, Kafka
  • Datastores: Postgres, Cassandra, Druid, Redis, BigQuery
  • Tools: Storybook, Playwright


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience as a software engineer
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in Frontend Engineering , especially with modern React
  • Ability to own features or projects from design to deployment
  • Comfortable with ambiguous problems , proposing clear and scalable solutions
  • Strong coding, testing, and documentation skills

Bonus if you have experience with:

  • Building modern, intuitive UIs and maintaining design systems
  • Using Storybook for UI component development
  • Implementing end-to-end testing with Playwright or similar frameworks

title: Backend Ops & Integrations Assistant
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.

We’re seeking experienced, detail-oriented backend ops & integrations assistants to join our growing team.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.


Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog, but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!


About You


  • You’re super motivated and genuinely passionate about nailing the job every time.
  • You’re an effective problem-solver who’s always a few steps ahead and never caught off guard.
  • You bring good vibes to the table—you’re respectful, friendly, and a great collaborator.
  • You’re great at time management.
  • You’re a team player.
  • Communication is your jam—clear, concise, and always spot-on.
  • You’re resourceful—if you don’t know something, you don’t flinch. You’ve got Google, you’ve got grit, and you always figure it out.
  • Bonus points if you geek out on things like DnD, Pokémon, or video games. Our team’s got some serious nerd cred, and we’re looking for like-minded peeps to join!


Qualifications and Skills


  • 2+ years of professional experience in backend web development
  • Proficiency in WordPress, Elementor, Webflow, and Shopify
  • Strong PHP skills
  • Impressive portfolio
  • Working level of English (enough to communicate your ideas clearly, both in writing and speaking)
  • A bachelor’s degree (a plus)
  • Proficiency in HTML, CSS, jQuery, and JavaScript
  • Expertise in responsive design and mobile-first approach
  • Able to optimize applications for maximum speed
  • Knowledge of HTML layout for the construction of email signatures and newsletters


About the Role


Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Supporting backend work on Webflow, WordPress, and Shopify
  • Managing integrations across HubSpot, Teamwork, Google Workspace, Webflow, Shopify, WordPress
  • Handling CMS updates, plugins, and troubleshooting
  • Configuring workflows and light automation (Zapier/Make)
  • Launching websites on Webflow, WordPress, or Shopify, including domain setup, DNS/SSL, CMS updates, and go-live QA


Our operating hours are Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST.


Ready for the ride of your life? If you think you’re the perfect fit for the role, submit your resume & portfolio today!

title: DevOps / Distributed Systems Engineer (Azure + Elixir + Linux)
description:
DevOps / Distributed Systems Engineer (Azure • Elixir • Linux )


Who We Are Seeking:


We seek a talented and experienced DevOps/Distributed Systems Engineer to operate and harden our Elixir services and Hyperledger Besu node network on Microsoft Azure to join our international team. This role presents an excellent opportunity for those looking to work in a dynamic environment and be part of a high-performing international team, offering ample opportunities for growth and development in technical and interpersonal skills. We seek an energetic, driven, and articulate team player who is truly passionate about their work.


Your Role and Responsibilities:  


  • Run Besu on Azure: manage validators/peers, permissioning, bootnodes, IBFT/QBFT configs, genesis updates, hard-fork rollouts, and RPC/WS endpoints behind Azure gateways.
  • Storage & performance: size and tune Besu (JVM/RocksDB) with Premium SSD v2 / Ultra Disk, optimize IOPS/throughput, and implement snapshot/restore pipelines via Azure Blob Storage.
  • Networking: build secure, private networking with VNets, subnets, Azure CNI (Cilium), Network Security Groups, Private Endpoints/Private Link, NAT Gateway, and VNet peering/ExpressRoute as needed.
  • Traffic & ingress: expose RPC/WS endpoints through Azure Application Gateway or Nginx Ingress with Web Application Firewall (WAF), mTLS, rate limits, and IP allowlists.
  • Secrets & keys: manage validator keys and app secrets with Azure Key Vault / Managed HSM, Managed Identities, and least-privilege RBAC via Microsoft Entra ID.
  • CI/CD & GitOps: ship immutable releases using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps Pipelines, ACR (image signing/scan), Helm, and Argo CD (or Flux) for environment promotion.
  • Observability & SRE: wire up Azure Monitor + Log Analytics, Managed Prometheus/Grafana (or self-managed Prometheus/Grafana), OpenTelemetry traces, Alert rules, runbooks, SLOs/error budgets.


Tech You’ll Use:


  • Blockchain: Hyperledger Besu (IBFT/QBFT, permissioning); Geth/Nethermind familiarity is a plus
  • Elixir: Elixir/OTP, Phoenix, Ecto, Oban, OpenTelemetry
  • Azure: AKS, ACR, Azure Monitor & Log Analytics, Managed Prometheus/Grafana, Key Vault / Managed HSM, Application Gateway/WAF, NAT Gateway, NSG, Private Link, Azure Firewall, Blob Storage, Managed Disks (Premium v2/Ultra), Azure Backup/Site Recovery, Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, Entra ID
  • IaC & CI/CD: Ansible, Terraform, GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps
  • Logging/Tracing: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki/ELK (optional), OpenTelemetry


Essential Qualifications:  


  • 4+ years in DevOps/SRE/Platform roles running distributed systems in production.
  • Hands-on experience operating EVM nodes (preferably Besu ) and tuning storage/IO, txpool, and pruning/archive modes.
  • Strong Azure background: AKS, VNet/NSG/Private Link, Key Vault, ACR, Azure Monitor/Log Analytics, and Application Gateway/WAF.
  • Solid Linux and networking fundamentals (TLS, DNS, routing, firewalls, load balancing).
  • Proven observability practice: metrics, logs, traces, actionable alerting, SLOs/runbooks.
  • Excellent written and spoken English (daily collaboration across teams).


Who We Are:


DevGrid is a top-tier software consulting company based in the UK, with a development hub in Brazil and operations spanning Europe and the US. We believe that world-class software can only be created by a motivated and enthusiastic team in an environment that fosters creativity and free thinking. Established in 2015, we aim to drive innovation and digital transformation by combining our robust business culture and exceptional engineers with forward-thinking business insights.


What We Offer:


  • Contract-based hiring;
  • Full-time opportunity (40 hours per week);
  • 100% remote work / home office;
  • Performance-based bonuses tied to achievements and deliverables;
  • Open and flexible time-off policy;
  • Supportive and collaborative work environment;
  • Equipment program;
  • Paid days off per year + holidays (variable) + recess days;
  • Sponsorship program for relevant courses and training.

title: DevOps / Distributed Systems Engineer (Azure + Elixir + Linux)
description:
DevOps / Distributed Systems Engineer (Azure • Elixir • Linux )


Who We Are Seeking:


We seek a talented and experienced DevOps/Distributed Systems Engineer to operate and harden our Elixir services and Hyperledger Besu node network on Microsoft Azure to join our international team. This role presents an excellent opportunity for those looking to work in a dynamic environment and be part of a high-performing international team, offering ample opportunities for growth and development in technical and interpersonal skills. We seek an energetic, driven, and articulate team player who is truly passionate about their work.


Your Role and Responsibilities:  


  • Run Besu on Azure: manage validators/peers, permissioning, bootnodes, IBFT/QBFT configs, genesis updates, hard-fork rollouts, and RPC/WS endpoints behind Azure gateways.
  • Storage & performance: size and tune Besu (JVM/RocksDB) with Premium SSD v2 / Ultra Disk, optimize IOPS/throughput, and implement snapshot/restore pipelines via Azure Blob Storage.
  • Networking: build secure, private networking with VNets, subnets, Azure CNI (Cilium), Network Security Groups, Private Endpoints/Private Link, NAT Gateway, and VNet peering/ExpressRoute as needed.
  • Traffic & ingress: expose RPC/WS endpoints through Azure Application Gateway or Nginx Ingress with Web Application Firewall (WAF), mTLS, rate limits, and IP allowlists.
  • Secrets & keys: manage validator keys and app secrets with Azure Key Vault / Managed HSM, Managed Identities, and least-privilege RBAC via Microsoft Entra ID.
  • CI/CD & GitOps: ship immutable releases using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps Pipelines, ACR (image signing/scan), Helm, and Argo CD (or Flux) for environment promotion.
  • Observability & SRE: wire up Azure Monitor + Log Analytics, Managed Prometheus/Grafana (or self-managed Prometheus/Grafana), OpenTelemetry traces, Alert rules, runbooks, SLOs/error budgets.


Tech You’ll Use:


  • Blockchain: Hyperledger Besu (IBFT/QBFT, permissioning); Geth/Nethermind familiarity is a plus
  • Elixir: Elixir/OTP, Phoenix, Ecto, Oban, OpenTelemetry
  • Azure: AKS, ACR, Azure Monitor & Log Analytics, Managed Prometheus/Grafana, Key Vault / Managed HSM, Application Gateway/WAF, NAT Gateway, NSG, Private Link, Azure Firewall, Blob Storage, Managed Disks (Premium v2/Ultra), Azure Backup/Site Recovery, Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, Entra ID
  • IaC & CI/CD: Ansible, Terraform, GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps
  • Logging/Tracing: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki/ELK (optional), OpenTelemetry


Essential Qualifications:  


  • 4+ years in DevOps/SRE/Platform roles running distributed systems in production.
  • Hands-on experience operating EVM nodes (preferably Besu ) and tuning storage/IO, txpool, and pruning/archive modes.
  • Strong Azure background: AKS, VNet/NSG/Private Link, Key Vault, ACR, Azure Monitor/Log Analytics, and Application Gateway/WAF.
  • Solid Linux and networking fundamentals (TLS, DNS, routing, firewalls, load balancing).
  • Proven observability practice: metrics, logs, traces, actionable alerting, SLOs/runbooks.
  • Excellent written and spoken English (daily collaboration across teams).

title: Analista de Suporte OSGT Sênior "980588"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?



O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:

  • Fornecer suporte técnico direto aos clientes focados na solução de Comércio Exterior (OSGT - OneSource Global Trade);
  • Utilizar a linguagem PL/SQL como base principal para todas as análises e investigações, criação de scripts para pequenas rotinas de manutenção;
  • Realizar investigações técnicas (debug) em PL/SQL com banco de dados ORACLE;
  • Atuar diretamente no monitoramento e troubleshooting das Integrações entre a OSGT;
  • Prestar atendimento ao cliente via telefone e/ou Teams, solucionando dúvidas e eventuais problemas da versão de forma eficaz;
  • Trabalhar com interação direta com todos os Módulos da OSGT (Importação, Exportação, Regimes Especiais, Drawback, etc);
  • Atuar em conjunto com diferentes departamentos para garantir a integração e funcionamento adequado dos sistemas;
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica detalhada sobre os processos e integrações realizadas
  • Analisar e documentar toda da análise técnica e funcional realizada para compartilhamento aos times de desenvolvimento.

O que você precisa ter :

  • Experiência como analista de suporte ao sistema OSGT (ONESOURCE Global Trade), nos módulos de Import, Export, Cambio Import e Cambio Export;
  • Experiência em PL/SQL para suporte técnico (debug de objetos base).

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

Accountant

Remote - Full Time


Join Trivium Group - Our award-winning team! Ranked #170 on the Inc. 5000 list and a Clutch Award-winning agency


At Trivium Group, we’re more than just a full-service Amazon agency—we’re a powerhouse of passionate experts helping brands scale profitably on Amazon. Our company thrives on strong systems, sharp people, and solid values—and now, we’re looking for an exceptional Accountant (Remote) to join our team!

✅ Competitive Salary $1,500 - $2,500 USD per month

✅ Fully Remote – Work from anywhere with a reliable internet connection

As an Accountant at Trivium Group, you will play a crucial role in managing financial data, ensuring compliance, and optimizing financial processes. Your expertise will drive accuracy, efficiency, and financial health for our business.

Maintain and reconcile financial transactions, ensuring accuracy and compliance

Oversee accounts payable, receivable, and payroll (60+ employees)

Verify and record financial transactions in the correct accounts

Detail-oriented with strong analytical skills

Full-time (40 hours/week)

description:
✨ Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional sênior para atuar na liderança de projetos estratégicos e de grande porte, garantindo cadência nas entregas, alinhamento com stakeholders e evolução contínua dos processos.

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar múltiplos times ou programas de grande porte, assegurando entregas de qualidade e dentro do prazo;

  • Vivência em gestão de múltiplos times ou programas de grande porte;
  • Alta capacidade de negociação e visão estratégica;
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de risco, KPIs e métricas de projeto ;
  • Perfil hands-on, com foco em resultados e melhoria contínua.

  • Certificações em gestão ágil ou tradicional (PMI, Scrum, SAFe, etc.);
  • Experiência em ambientes de transformação digital.

title: Hotel API Consultant
description:
Adecco, líder mundial de soluções de RH, está presente em 60 países, com mais de 5.500 filiais em que trabalham mais de 30.000 pessoas, em parceria com mais de 100.000 empresas clientes, distribuídas por todo o mundo. Oferecemos uma ampla variedade de serviços voltados para Recursos Humanos.


Assessoramos para uma importante empresa multinacional no segmento do Turismo !


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Medir o desempenho de clientes e do site, e desenvolver planos técnicos/produto claros para aumentar os volumes.
  • Maximizar a distribuição dos produtos sob uma perspectiva técnica.
  • Coordenar entre o cliente e a equipe de onboarding durante o processo de integração.
  • Monitorar o desempenho das APIs dos clientes atribuídos diariamente.
  • Oferecer expertise técnica sobre a integração de produtos e serviços, com apoio de especialistas quando necessário.
  • Trabalhar com o time de vendas para desenvolver planos de visitação/contato com os clientes de forma eficiente.
  • Engajar-se ativamente com vendas, produto, suporte e times de desenvolvimento de API para resolver problemas de suporte após o go-live.
  • Relatar quaisquer problemas à matriz, classificando a prioridade e o impacto comercial.
  • Coordenar com o time de vendas sobre questões comerciais ou técnicas que possam impactar as vendas.
  • Ser o primeiro ponto de contato para clientes e integradores da região para questões relacionadas às APIs.


Requisitos


  • Diploma de Bacharel em qualquer área de Tecnologia (preferencial).
  • Experiência em função de contato direto com cliente.
  • Conhecimento de REST API, XML, JSON e tecnologias similares.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados e SQL.
  • Inglês Avançado.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Conversational AI)
description:
Company Description

Yuna's mission is to radically transform the way mental health support is accessed and delivered. By providing 24/7 instant and private support at the push of a button, we aim to address the significant gaps in mental health care accessibility. In a system where waiting times for therapists can reach up to 48 days and many people can't even afford care, Yuna is the answer to immediate mental health support needs.

We’re growing quickly, and every person who joins us plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of mental health technology.


Position Overview

You’ll be the backbone behind Yuna’s conversational stack—owning services, data, and runtime that make our AI safe, fast, and reliable at scale. You’ll partner with the Staff ML Engineer to turn models into resilient, observable, HIPAA-aware product experiences.


What you’ll do

  • Design, build, and operate services for conversation state, user memory, retrieval, and tool integrations (REST/gRPC).
  • Work closely with clinical psychologists (both internal and external to Yuna), ensuring the efficacy of Yuna’s conversational AI
  • Collaborate with front end teams for API creation, QA, and implementation
  • Implement alignment & safety layers (e.g., self-harm detection, red-teaming, refusal strategies, escalation paths) tuned to clinical guidelines
  • Optimize for latency, cost, and quality
  • Partner tightly with product, sales, and users to scope new features and


What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years building backend systems in production (Go/Python/NodeJS), with strong systems and API design skills
  • Hands-on experience with AI agents, RAG pipelines, and LLMs
  • Cloud infrastructure expertise (Google Cloud Platform)
  • Proficiency with relational + vector/search systems and real-time communication (sockets, WebRTC)
  • Nice to have: Swift (iOS client integration)
  • Strong product sense; you care about user outcomes, not just model metrics
  • Comfort working with ambiguity and creating systems 0 to 1


Location: Remote (work from anywhere, with at least 6 hours overlap with PST)

Employment Type: Full Time


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary (based on experience) + equity options
  • Remote-first culture with flexibility
  • A fast-growing, talented, and empathetic team dedicated to transforming mental health care
  • The opportunity to make a real-world impact, building cutting-edge AI systems and real-time communication platforms that improve lives every day

title: Instructional Designer
description:
ADP is hiring a Learning Design Consultant (Instructional Designer).


In this role, you will focus primarily on applying efficient and agile design approaches to develop innovative, engaging learning solutions, using ADP learning design standards and tools, to meet the learning needs of ADP associates and clients.


No two days are the same. You will do everything from creating design documents, testing and deploying content, conducting needs assessments across multiple business lines, establishing training plans, overseeing translations, measuring results, and more. You will do this all to the highest standards with an eye on appealing to multi-generational talent and the modern learner and by partnering across the learning organization to apply innovative techniques in instructional design. You can create compelling content and convey ideas and information to many levels of an organization.


To thrive in the role, you have 3+ years of experience in the learning - development field. You have worked independently to design and develop sound training in various modalities, i.e., eLearning, instructor-led, blended, job aids, and more, and can manage simultaneous projects with deadlines. It would be best to be a continuous learner who focuses on personal development and business process improvement to our design standards. Your work will help our businesses support our clients who employ one to millions of employees.


Like what you see? Apply now!


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Innovation : You seek opportunities to apply innovative design thinking to your projects and will work to keep ADP's approach to designing learning up to date with the products and solutions ADP offers its clients.
  • Flexibility and Agility : You can adapt to changing business requirements, projects, and resources and use agile approaches to meet business needs.
  • Design: You'll design holistic solutions engaging team members and business partners in the design process to ensure the solution design is flexible and addresses the unique needs of the learners. Solution design should consider and factor in how the work environment impacts learning.
  • Development: You can develop solutions across a broad set of learning modalities and tools without creating redundant solutions and ensure that continuous learning and performance support concepts are applied.
  • Learning Outcomes: You measure your outcomes and ensure your learning solutions result in the intended business impact.
  • Continuous Learner: You focus on personal development to develop and elevate professional knowledge and skill. You take the same approach to business process improvement to improve ADP learning design standards and drive the adoption of those standards. You maintain an outside-in perspective by building and maintaining peer networks inside and outside ADP.


TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

A college degree is not required but could set you apart. What's more important is having the skills and experience to do the job. You will need 3+ years of experience in instructional development, adult learning theory, and/or technical writing.

Other things that will set you apart:

  • Experience using eLearning tools such as Captivate, Articulate 360 , Synthesia, TechSmith Camtasia , TechSmith SnagIt, Audacity, and Vyond. Technical aptitude to quickly learn new development tools.
  • Experience using a Learning Management System (i.e., Litmos)
  • Experience with simple Graphic Design


Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in the learning and development field
  • Ability to systematically design, develop, and implement learning content that meets specific organizational needs
  • Skilled in building learning solutions for English-speaking audiences
  • Proficient in Articulate Storyline, Rise, Synthesia, or similar authoring tools
  • Working knowledge of Learning Management Systems (upload/manage content, apply technical standards, etc.)
  • Proven success collaborating virtually


YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Collaborate. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and respect one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner - doer. Mission-driven and committed to navigating change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.


Learn more here:

What are you waiting for? Apply now!

title: Staff ML Engineer (Conversational AI)
description:
Company Description

Yuna's mission is to radically transform the way mental health support is accessed and delivered. By providing 24/7 instant and private support at the push of a button, we aim to address the significant gaps in mental health care accessibility. In a system where waiting times for therapists can reach up to 48 days and many people can't even afford care, Yuna is the answer to immediate mental health support needs.

We’re growing quickly, and every person who joins us plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of mental health technology.


Position Overview

You’ll own Yuna’s core conversational intelligence (i.e. spanning retrieval, memory, safety, evaluation, and post-training). You’ll ship user-visible improvements quickly while raising the bar on empathy, reliability, and guardrails. This is a hands-on staff-level role: equal parts research-to-production and platform thinking.


What you’ll do

  • Lead the end-to-end model lifecycle of Yuna’s conversational AI: problem framing → data curation → modeling/fine-tuning/post-training → evals → rollout → monitoring
  • Work closely with clinical psychologists (both internal and external to Yuna), ensuring the efficacy of Yuna’s conversational AI
  • Design agentic flows (tool use, planning, multi-turn memory) and safe retrieval for mental-health use cases
  • Build and own the evaluation flywheel: benchmarks, judge models, rubrics for conversational quality, ability to help, safety
  • Implement alignment & safety layers (e.g., self-harm detection, red-teaming, refusal strategies, escalation paths) tuned to clinical guidelines
  • Optimize for latency, cost, and quality
  • Partner tightly with product, sales, and users to scope new features and
  • Establish LLMOps: datasets, prompts/checkpoints/versioning, observability, drift monitoring, and incident response for model quality


What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years in ML/AI with 3+ shipping LLM/NLP systems in production
  • Deep skill in Python and modern deep learning stacks (PyTorch/JAX/TensorFlow), retrieval/RAG, embeddings, reranking, and long-context summarization
  • Experience building agentic systems (tool calling, decomposition, memory) and rigorous eval harnesses (offline + online)
  • Strong product sense; you care about user outcomes, not just model metrics
  • Comfort working with ambiguity and creating systems 0 to 1


Location: Remote (work from anywhere, with at least 6 hours overlap with PST)

Employment Type: Full Time


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary (based on experience) + equity options
  • Remote-first culture with flexibility
  • A fast-growing, talented, and empathetic team dedicated to transforming mental health care
  • The opportunity to make a real impact on the world, building cutting-edge AI systems that improve lives every day

title: Analista de Recrutamento e Seleção Junior - PCD
description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 140 centros de distribuição, /o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos. Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.


O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Analista de Recrutamento e Seleção apaixonada por diversidade e inclusão, com experiência em conduzir processos seletivos de ponta a ponta, especialmente em ambientes com alto volume de vagas e perfis variados. Esta é uma oportunidade exclusiva para profissionais PCDs que desejam fazer a diferença promovendo um ambiente mais plural e representativo.



Responsabilidades


  • Conduzir processos seletivos de diferentes níveis e áreas (foco em posições operacionais)
  • Atuar com alto volume de vagas simultâneas, garantindo agilidade e qualidade na entrega;
  • Desenvolver estratégias de atração com foco em diversidade;
  • Realizar triagens, entrevistas por competências e dinâmicas de grupo;
  • Apoiar na construção de parcerias com consultorias e instituições voltadas à inclusão;
  • Garantir uma experiência positiva para todas as pessoas candidatas;
  • Alimentar e manter atualizados os sistemas de recrutamento (ATS);


Requisitos


  • Ensino superior completo em Psicologia, Administração, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia com recrutamento e seleção, especialmente em vagas de volume;
  • Conhecimento em entrevistas por competências e ferramentas de avaliação comportamental;
  • Vivência com ações afirmativas e programas de diversidade e inclusão;
  • Desejável conhecimento em sistemas de ATS/Plataformas de divulgações;


Benefícios:


  • Assistência médica e odontológica estendida a dependentes;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale-alimentação;
  • Wellhub;
  • Participação nos lucros;
  • Descontos em produtos;
  • Programas de saúde e bem-estar;

title: Senior Software Engineer (Ruby Expert)
description:
Pride Global is hiring a Senior Software Engineer (Ruby Expert) in Brazil. Please apply for consideration!!


Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ


Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our innovative team. You will develop high-quality, performant, and testable code contributing directly to company-wide initiatives using exciting technologies such as Elixir, Ruby, React, Typescript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS Lambda, PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB.

You’ll have a strong influence on technical decisions, collaborate closely with product and engineering teams, and continuously improve your skills and our systems.


Responsibilities

  • Write high-quality, performant, and testable code aligned with company initiatives
  • Develop using technologies like Elixir, Ruby, React, Typescript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS Lambda, PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB
  • Contribute to technical decision-making shaping the software’s future
  • Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback
  • Collaborate with team members on feature development
  • Deploy user-facing code to production
  • Partner with product and engineering management to deliver solutions


Required Qualifications

  • Professional English fluency (written and spoken)
  • 3-5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong communication skills
  • Experience with reusable components and building component libraries
  • Understanding of production-ready web applications and systems
  • Passion for testing practices and continuous improvement
  • Experience with any of: Elixir, Erlang, Ruby, Javascript, Next.js, or other programming languages
  • Familiarity with tools such as IDEs, RESTful APIs, Git, TypeScript, version control, and remote deployment
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of event-based architectures, database fundamentals, and GraphQL
  • Enthusiasm for problem-solving and curiosity about retail/e-commerce, high-end consignment market, and sustainable circular economy for luxury goods

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento de Software Pl - (Backend)
description:
Sobre a empresa:


Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!


Aqui temos um ambiente dinâmico, que celebra a diversidade, promove a inclusão e está sempre em busca dos melhores resultados! Acreditamos no poder transformador da tecnologia e na sua capacidade de contribuir para a construção de uma sociedade mais diversa e inclusiva. Por isso, temos compromisso com nossa política e programa de diversidade e inclusão para garantirmos um ecossistema cada vez mais representativo, respeitoso e acolhedor.


#ouseetransforme #sejaTOTVS


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:


  • Desenvolver soluções técnicas de média complexidade, com nível de supervisão moderado e pouco apoio, através do desenvolvimento de requisitos de softwares utilizando-se das tecnologias back-end envolvidas no projeto;
  • Compreender a arquitetura back-end do software e ser capaz de atuar nela através da análise de seus componentes, organização e funcionalidades;
  • Criar testes de média complexidade, sejam estes manuais ou automatizados, que cubram o comportamento desejado dos componentes técnicos desenvolvidos utilizando os requisitos e ferramentas de testes;
  • Documentar as etapas de desenvolvimento realizando o registro nas ferramentas de versionamento e documentação;
  • Trabalhar com o time de desenvolvimento para encontrar soluções de negócio, arquitetura e desenho através da comunicação e trocas de conhecimento;
  • Manter a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio;
  • Detalhar requisitos de baixa e média complexidade através do contato com clientes e áreas envolvidas no projeto/atendimento.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:


  • Lógica de Programação e Estrutura de Dados: Conhecimento aprofundado para resolver problemas de forma eficiente.
  • Banco de Dados: Experiência intermediária com modelagem, consultas e otimização em diferentes tipos de bancos de dados (relacionais, NoSQL, etc.).
  • Cloud Computing: Familiaridade com serviços de nuvem, preferencialmente AWS, mas outras plataformas são bem-vindas.
  • Linguagens de Programação: Experiência comprovada em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação de backend relevante para o mercado (ex: Java Script, Node.js, TypeScript para backend, entre outras).
  • Frameworks de Backend: Entendimento e experiência intermediária com o uso de frameworks modernos de backend (ex: Spring Boot, Express.js, Django, Ruby on Rails, ASP.NET Core, Laravel, etc.).
  • Testes e Qualidade: Experiência intermediária com testes unitários, de integração e automação de testes para garantir a qualidade do código.
  • Arquitetura de Software: Conhecimento básico sobre diferentes padrões e conceitos de arquitetura de software (microsserviços, monolito, cliente-servidor, APIs RESTful/GraphQL).
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Compreensão básica e experiência com métodos ágeis de desenvolvimento de software (Scrum, Kanban, etc.).


Benefícios:


  • Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada pessoa colaboradora;
  • Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
  • Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para nossas pessoas colaboradoras;
  • Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para pessoas colaboradoras e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...
  • Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;
  • Vale transporte e fretados em algumas estações do metrô;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
  • Espaço de lactário;
  • Bicicletário;
  • Vestiário;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;
  • Gympass.

  • Criar testes de média complexidade, sejam estes manuais ou automatizados, que cubram o comportamento desejado dos componentes técnicos desenvolvidos utilizando os requisitos e ferramentas de testes;
  • Documentar as etapas de desenvolvimento realizando o registro nas ferramentas de versionamento e documentação;
  • Trabalhar com o time de desenvolvimento para encontrar soluções de negócio, arquitetura e desenho através da comunicação e trocas de conhecimento;
  • Manter a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio;
  • Detalhar requisitos de baixa e média complexidade através do contato com clientes e áreas envolvidas no projeto/atendimento.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:


  • Lógica de Programação e Estrutura de Dados: Conhecimento aprofundado para resolver problemas de forma eficiente.
  • Banco de Dados: Experiência intermediária com modelagem, consultas e otimização em diferentes tipos de bancos de dados (relacionais, NoSQL, etc.).
  • Cloud Computing: Familiaridade com serviços de nuvem, preferencialmente AWS, mas outras plataformas são bem-vindas.
  • Linguagens de Programação: Experiência comprovada em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação de backend relevante para o mercado (ex: Java Script, Node.js, TypeScript para backend, entre outras).
  • Frameworks de Backend: Entendimento e experiência intermediária com o uso de frameworks modernos de backend (ex: Spring Boot, Express.js, Django, Ruby on Rails, ASP.NET Core, Laravel, etc.).
  • Testes e Qualidade: Experiência intermediária com testes unitários, de integração e automação de testes para garantir a qualidade do código.
  • Arquitetura de Software: Conhecimento básico sobre diferentes padrões e conceitos de arquitetura de software (microsserviços, monolito, cliente-servidor, APIs RESTful/GraphQL).

title: Junior Entrepreneur
description:
• LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
  • WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
  • BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?


Oneday is a VC-backed EdTech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.


We have raised $19M in seed funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.


If you are:

  • Passionate about startups and entrepreneurship
  • Have a positive mindset and good sense of humour
  • Organised, detail oriented and diligent
  • Great at communicating in English - both verbally and in writing (video chats, emails, texts)


…then get in touch!


We are looking for people who have all of the above qualities for multiple full-time roles including Customer Success, Business Development, Community and more.


What you’ll get:


  • Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
  • Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis
